title: Accessibility: WCAG and levels A, AA and AAA

videos.script:
One person in six lives with a significant disability. {{who}} And everyone else meets the same barriers for an afternoon: a broken arm, a phone in the sun, a noisy train.

The standard that says what an accessible page is, is WCAG. {{wcag}} Version 2.2 has eighty-six success criteria, each a statement a page passes or fails, and each with a level. The target is AA.

Today a machine checks the planner. {{axe}} axe runs inside the page and reports every rule it breaks. It finds two problems: icons with no text alternative, and a grey too pale to read.

Two lines fix them, {{fix}} and a test keeps them fixed.

Then the honest part. {{limits}} A machine finds about half of what a person finds. The rest of this course is the other half.
